m: माधव mf(ई)n. (fr. मधु; f(आ). only in माधवा [= मधव्या] तनूः, Pāṇ. iv, 4, 129, Sch.) relating to spring, vernal, Hariv.; Vikr.; Kathās.
belonging or peculiar to the descendants of Madhu i.e. the Yādavas, Hariv.
representing Kṛṣṇa (as a picture), Hcat.
माधव m. N. of the second month of spring (more usually called Vaiśākha, = April-May), TS. &c. &c. spring, Kāv.; Pañcar.
Bassia Latifolia, L.
Latifolia, L.
Phaseolus Mungo, L.
a son or descendant of Madhu, a man of the race of Yadu (sg. esp. N. of Kṛṣṇa-Viṣṇu or of Paraśu-rāma as an incarnation of this god; pl. the Yādavas or Vṛṣṇis), MBh.; R.; Hariv.; BhP.
N. of Śiva, Śivag.
of Indra, Pañcat.; Vet. (w.r. for वासव?)
of a son of the third Manu, Hariv.
of one of the 7 sages under Manu Bhautya, MārkP.
of the hero of Bhava-bhūti's drama Mālatī-mādhava
of various other men, Kathās.; Hit. &c.
of various scholars and poets (also with पण्डित, भट्ट, मिश्र, योगिन्, वैद्य, सरस्वती &c.; cf. माधवाचार्य)
माधव n. sweetness, L.
(also m.) a partic. intoxicating drink, L.
a: माधव — a. (वी f.) [मधु-अण्] 1 Honey-like sweet. --2 Made of honey. --3 Vernal, relating to the spring; सावज्ञेव मुखप्रसाधनविधौ श्रीमाधवी योषितां M. 3. 5. --4 Relating to the descendants of Madhu. --वः [माया लक्ष्म्या धवः] 1 N. of Kṛṣṇa; राधामाधवयोर्जयंति यमुनाकूले रहःकेलयः Gīt. 1; माधवे मा कुरु मानिनि मानमये 9. --2 he spring season, a friend of Cupid; स्मर पर्युत्सुक एष माधवः Ku. 4. 28; म माधवेनाभिमतेन सख्या (अनुप्रयातः) 3. 23. --3 The month called Vaiśākha; भास्करस्य मधुमाधवाविव R. 11. 7. --4 N. of Indra. --5 N. of Paraśurāma. --6 N. of the Yādavas (pl.); Śi. 16 52. --7 N. of a celebrated author, son of Māyaṇa and brother of Sāyaṇa and Bhoganātha, and supposed to have lived in the fifteenth century. He was a very reputed scholar, numerous important works being ascribed to him; he and Sāyaṇa are supposed to have jointly written the commentary on the Ṛgveda; श्रुतिस्मृतिसदाचारपालको माधवो बुध . स्मार्तं व्याख्याय सर्वार्थं द्विज र्थ श्रोत उद्यतः . J. N. V. --Comp. --उचित a kind of perfume (कक्कंल) --वल्ली = माधवी q. v. --श्री vernal beauty.

m: माधुर mf(ई)n. relating to or coming from Madhura or Madhurā, R.
माधुर n. the blossom of Jasminum Zambac, L.
a: माधुरं — [मधुर-अण्] Tho flower of the Mallikā creeper.

m: माधुरि f. = माधुरी, sweetness, loveliness, Bhojapr.
माधुर्य n. sweetness, Kāv.; Suśr.
loveliness, exquisite beauty, charm, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
(with Vaiṣṇavas) a feeling of tender affection (for Kṛṣṇa like that of a girl for her lover), RTL. 141
(in rhet.) grace of style (esp. consisting in the employment of separated words in a sentence, as opp. to श्लेष, q.v.), Vām.; Kpr. &c.
माधुर्य mfn. sweetly speaking, Kull. on Mn. x, 33.
a: माधुर्यं — [मधुरस्य भावः ष्यञ्] 1 Sweetness. pleasantness; माधुर्यपीष्टे हरिणान् ग्रहीतुं R. 18. 13, Bh. 2. 6. --2 Attractive beauty. exquisite beauty; रूपं किमप्यनिर्वाच्य तनोर्माधुर्यमुच्यते. --3 (In Rhet.) Sweetness, one of the three (accord ing to Mammaṭa) chief Guṇas in poetic compositions; चितद्रवीभावमयो ह्लादो माधुर्यपुच्यते S. D. 606: see K. P. 8 also. --4 Kindness, amiability.

m: माधुर्य—कदम्बिनी f. N. of wk.

s: klI, (maDurasTa BAvaH : maDura + “varRadfQAByaH zyaY ca .” 5 । 1 । 123 । iti zyaY .) maDurasya BAvaH । maDuratvam । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 173 । (yaTA, suSrute sUtrasTAne ekAdaSADyADe । “mADuryyaM Bajate'tyarTaM tIkzRaBAvaM vimuYcati ॥”) lAvaRyam । yaTA, -- “rUpaM kimapyanirvvAcyaM tanormADuryyamucyate .” ityujjvalanIlamaRiH ॥ pAYcAlIrItiviSizwakAvyaguRaH । yaTA, -- “maDurAM sukumArAYca pAYcAlIM kavayo viduH .” iti sAhityadarpaRe 9 paricCedaH ॥ tasya lakzaRaM yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe 8 paricCede । “cittadravIBAvamayo hlAdo mADuryyamucyate । samBoge karuRe vipralamBe SAnte'DikaM kramAt ॥ mUrdDni vargAntyavarRena yuktAzwa Wa qa QAn vinA । raRO laGu ca tadvyaktO varRAH kAraRatAM gatAH ॥ avfttiralpavfttirvA maDurA racanA taTA .” (nAyikAnAmayatnajo'laMkAraviSezaH । yaTA, sAhityadarpaRe । 3 । 129 । “saNkzoBezvapyanudvego mADuryyaM parikIrttitam .” sAttvikanAyakaguRaBedaH । yaTA, tatrEva । 3 । 91 । “sarvAvasTAviSezezu mADuryyaM ramaRIyatA .”)
v: na॰ maDurasya BAvaH zyaY । 1 maDuratve “cittadravIBAvamayo hlAdo mADuryyamucyate” sA॰ da॰ ukte 2 kAvya guRaBede ca । tadvyaYjakavarRASca tatroktA yaTA “mUrdDni vargAntyavarRena yuktAH waWaqaQAn vinA । raRO laGu ca tadvyaktO varRAH kAraRatAM gatAH । avfttiralpavfttirvA maDurA racanA manA” । tacca samBogaSfNgAdAvanuguRaM yaToktaM tatrEva “samBoge karuRe vipralamBe SAnte'DikaM kramAt 3 lAvaRye hema॰ । “rUpaM kimapyanirvAcyaM tanormADuryyamucyate” ujjvalamaRO tallakzaRamuktam ।

m: माधु—तैलिक mfn. (fr. मधु + तैल) prepared from honey and oil, Suśr.

s: strI, (maDuno vikAraH । maDu + aR । NIp । “ftvyavAstvyavAstvamADvIti .” 6 । 4 । 175 । aRi striyAM yaRAdeSo nipAtyate .) madyam । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ maDvAdikftA surA । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥ (yaTA, manO । 11 । 95 । “gOqI pEzwI ca mADvI ca vijYeyA triviDA surA .” maDu maDuraraso'styasya kaRwakAvacCede aR .) maDurakaRwakamatsyaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥ (maDumati, tri । yaTA, fgvede । 7 । 71 । 2 । “divAnaktaM mADvI trAsITAM naH ॥” he mADvI ! maDumantO ॥ iti tadBAzye sAyaNaH ॥ nadIviSezaH । yaTA, mAtsye । 120 । 71 । “teByaH SAntA ca mADvI ca dve nadyO samprasUyAtAm .”)
m: माध्वी f. (Pāṇ. vi, 4, 175) sweet, RV. (i, 90, 6; 8); ŚBr.; TS.; BhP.
a kind of intoxicating liquor, Mn. xi, 94
Gaertnera Racemosa, Vās.
a date, L.
a species of fish, L.
N. of a woman (an ardent worshipper of Viṣṇu), W.
du. ‘the two sweet ones’, N. of the Aśvins, RV.; VS.; AV.; TS.
pl. the waters, MaitrS.; TS.
माध्वीका f. Dolichos Sinensis, L.

s: klI, (mADvI + svArTe kan .) maDUkapuzpakftamadyam । tatparyyAyaH । maDvAsavaH 2 mADavakaH 3 maDu 4 । ityamaraH । 2 । 10 । 41 ॥ maDumADvIkamityekaM nAmeti kecit ॥ pUrvvO dbO puzpamadye । (yaTA, mahABArate । 3 । 277 । 39 । “kaTaM hi pItvA mADvIkaM pItvA ca maDumADavIm । loBaM sOvIrake kuryyAnnArI kAciditi smare ॥”) parO dvO drAkzAvikAre । iti BarataH ॥ mAddIMkamiti vA pAWaH । iti ramAnATaH । mADvIkasTAne mADvakamiti BAnudIkzitaH ॥ (maDu । yaTA, nEzaDe । 19 । 33 । “Dayatu naline mADvIkaM vA na vA'BinavAgataH । kumudamakarandOGEH kukzimBarirBramarotkaraH । iha tu lihate rAtrItarzaM raTANgavihaNgamA maDu nijabaDUvaktrAmBoje'DunA'DaranAmakam ॥” “mADvIkaM makarandam । iti tawwIkAyAM nArAyaRaH ॥) tatparyyAyo yaTA, -- “maDumAkzIkamADvIkakzOdrasAraDyamIritam । makzikAvarawIBfNgavAtapuzparasodBavam ॥” iti BAvaprakASasya pUrvvaKaRqe dvitIye BAge ॥)
v: strI maDunA maDUkapuzpeRa nirvfttam Ikak । 1 maDUkapuzpajAte madye amaraH । maDu eva aR svArTe Ikak । 2 drA Pale “sADvI mADvIka! cintA vijahatviti jayadevaH ।
m: माध्वीक n. a kind of intoxicating drink, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (cf. मधु-माध्वीक and माधवक)
a: माध्वीकं — [मधुना मधूकपुऽपेण निर्वृत्तं ईकक्] 1 A kind of spirituous liquor, distilled from the flowers of the tree called Madhūka; चचाम मधु माध्वीकं Bk. 14. 94. --2 Wine distilled from grapes; साध्वी माध्वीक चिंता न भवति भवतः Gīt. 12 (= मधो Com.). --3 A grape. --Comp. --फलं a kind of cocoa-nut.

s: puM, (mADvIkaM maDumat Palamasya .) maDunAlikerikaH । iti rAjanirGaRwaH ॥
v: pu॰ mADvIkamiva maDuraM Palamasya । maDunArikele rAjani॰ ।
m: माध्वीक—फल m. a species of cocoa-nut tree, L.

v: pu॰ mADvIkamiva maDurA pfzo॰ kalopaH । maDuraKarjUrikAyAm rAjani॰ ।
m: माध्वी—मधुरा f. a species of date, L.
माध्व m. an adherent of Madhva (see p. 782, col. 3), W.
a: माध्व — a. (ध्वी f.) Sweet. --ध्वः A follower of Madhva. --ध्वी 1 A kind of liquor (made from honey). --2 The creeper called Mādhavī.

m: माध्वश्वि m. (fr. मध्व्-अश्व), Pat.
माध्वक n. = माधवक, L.
माध्वक ˚विक, माध्वी See p. 808, col. 3.
a: माध्वकं — An intoxicating drink prepared from honey.

m: माध्व—सिद्धान्त-सार m. N. of wk.
माध्विक m. a person who collects honey, MBh.
a: माध्विकः — A person who collects honey.

m: माध्याह्निक mf(ई)n. (fr. मध्याह्न) belonging to midday, taking place at noon, MārkP.
a: माध्याह्निक — a. (की f.) Belonging to noon.

m: माध्याह्निक—मन्त्र m. n. N. of wk.
माध्याह्निक—संध्या-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
माध्या-वर्ष mfn. celebrated in the middle of the rainy reason, Hir.
माध्य mfn. (fr. मध्य, of which it is also the Vṛddhi form in comp.) middle, central, mid, TS.
a: माध्य — a. [मध्य आण्] Central, middle.

k.v: माध्यं कुन्दं रक्तकस्तु बन्धूको बन्धुजीवकः। सहा कुमारी तरणिरम्लानस्तु महासहा॥

m: माध्य—ं-दि˚नारण्यक-व्याख्या f. N. of wk.
माध्य—ं-दिनायन m. (prob. fr. मध्यं-दिन) N. of a teacher, BṛĀrUp.
माध्य—ं-दिनी (ई), f. (with शिक्षा), N. of wk.
माध्य—ं-दिनीय mf(आ)n. (fr. माध्यंदिन) usual at the midday oblation (also ˚यक), ŚrS.
belonging to the school of the Mādhyaṃdinas, Cat.
माध्य—ं-दिन (माध्˚), mf(ई)n. (fr. मध्यं-दिन) belonging to midday, meridional, RV. &c. &c.
माध्य—ं-दिन m. = माध्यंदिनः पवनः, ŚāṅkhŚr.
pl. N. of a branch of the Vājasaneyins, Inscr. &c. (cf. IW. 150; 245, 2)
of an astron. school who fixed the starting-point of planetary movements at noon, Col.
of a family, Pravar.
माध्य—ं-दिन n. = माध्यंदिनं सवनम्, KātyŚr.
N. of a Tīrtha, Cat.
a: माध्यंदिन — a. (नी f.) 1 Midday, meridional. --2 Middle, central --नः N. of a branch of Vājasaneyins. --नं A branch of the शुक्ल or white Yajurveda (followed by the Mādhyandinas).

m: माध्य—ं-दिन—शाखा f. the school of the Mādhyaṃdinas (˚खीय. mfn. belonging to it), Cat.
माध्य—ं-दिन—शाखीय mfn., belonging to the school of the Mādhyaṃdinas
माध्य—ं-दिन—गृह्य n. N. of wk.
माध्य—ं-दिन—संध्या-प्रयोग m. N. of wk.
माध्य—ं-दिन—संहिता f. N. of wk.
माध्य—ं-दिन—वत् ind. as at the midday oblation, KātyŚr.
माध्य—ं-दिनेय m. pl. the school of the M˚s ib.
माध्य—ं-दिनि m. (fr. id.) N. of a grammarian, Kār. on Pāṇ. vii, 1, 94.

s: tri, (maDye BavaM । maDya + “antaHpUrvvapadAwWaY .” 4 । 3 । 60 । ityasya kASikAsUtravfttO “maRmIyO ca pratyayO vaktavyO .” iti maR .) maDye Bavam । yaTA, -- “maDyamaM mADyamaM maDyamIyaM mADyandinaYca tat .” iti hemacandraH । 6 । 96 ॥
m: माध्यम mfn. (fr. मध्यम) relating to the middle, middlemost, central (also applied to the composers of the middle portion of the Ṛg-veda i.e. of books ii-vii), ŚāṅkhBr.; GṛS.; Pat.
middle-born, W.
माध्यम m. pl. N. of a race, Pravar.
a: माध्यम — a. (मी f.) [मध्यम-अण्] Be longing to the middle portion, central, middle, middlemost.

m: माध्यमक mf(इका)n. (fr. मध्यम) relating to the middle region (i.e. the atmosphere), Nir.
a: माध्यमक — a. (मिका f.) माध्यमिक a. (की f.) Middle, central. --काः (m. pl.) N. of a people or their country in the central part of India.

m: माध्यम˚केय m. pl. N. of a people, MBh. (v.l. मध्यमकेय).
माध्यम—स्थ्य n. (fr. मध्यम-स्थ) g. ब्राह्मणादि.
माध्यमिका f. N. of the middle portion of the Kāṭhaka.
माध्यमि˚कीय mfn. = मध्यमिकायाम् भवः, Pat.
माध्यमिक mfn. (fr. मध्यम) = मध्यमक, Nir. (also applied to a kind of cloth, Pat.)
माध्यमिक m. pl. N. of a Buddhist school, MWB. 157; 159
माध्यमिक m. of a people in central India, VarBṛS.
माध्यमिनेय m. metron. fr. मध्यमा, g. कल्याण्य्-आदि.

s: tri, (maDye Bavam । maDya + “antaHpUrvvapadAt WaY .” 4 । 3 । 60 । ityatrakASikA sUtravfttO “maDyomaDyaM dinaR cAsmAt .” iti dinaR .) maDyamam । iti hemacandraH । 6 । 96 ॥ (maDyandinasambanDi । yaTA, fgvede । 3 । 28 । 4 । “mADyandine savane jAtavedaH puroqASamiha kave ! juzasva .” “mADyandine maDyandinasambanDini” taTA “mADyandine maDyaM dinasyedamityarTe utsAditvAdaY YitvAdAdivfdDiH YitvAdevAdyudAttatvam .” iti ca tadBAzye sAyaNaH ॥ maDyandinena proktADItA vA । ityaR NIp । Suklayajurvedasya SAKABedaH । yaTA, ASvalAyanIyaSrOtasUtre । 5 । 5 । 19 । “pibA somamaBiyamugratarda iti tisro'rvANehi somakAmaM tvAhustavAyaM somastvamehyarvANindrAya somAH pra divo vidAnA A pUrRo asya kalaSaH svAheti mADyandinyaH .”)
v: na॰ maDyandinameva--aR । maDyamadine tatra pAWyaH aR । SuklayajurvedIyaSAsvABede ।

s: klI, (maDyasTa + zyaY .) maDyasTasya BAvaH । maDyasTakaraRam । yaTA, kumArasamBave । 1 । 52 । “ayAcitAraM nahi devadevamadriH sutAM grAhayituM SaSAka । aByarTanABaNgaBayena sADurmADyasTyamizwe'pyavalambate'rTe ॥”
m: माध्य—स्थ mfn. (fr. मध्य-स्थ) being in a middle state, indifferent, impartial, Kām.
माध्य—स्थ n. indifference, impartiality, Mn. iv, 257.
a: माध्यस्थं, माध्यस्थ्यं — 1 Impartiality. --2 Indifference, unconcern; अभ्यर्थनाभंगभयेन साधुर्माध्यस्थ्यमिष्टेऽप्यवलंबतेर्थे Ku. 1. 52. --3 Intercession, mediation.

m: माध्य—स्थ्य n. (fr. मध्य-स्थ) = prec. n., Dhūrtas.
intercession, mediation, W.

a: माध्यस्य — a. Indifferent, impartial, neutral.
